editions.source: Edicao da manha de terca 17/11. Varredura direta no xread (26 handles, janela 00:03Z-12:03Z, 24 posts); logs de 17/11 dos reporteres nao lidos nesta rodada (teto de ferramentas) — lacuna declarada.

posts.pt: Mantle: 'onchain nao tem pais de origem', alcance e a vantagem real da tokenizacao. Post de parceiro, tese identica a nossa, e com UMA resposta: espaco aberto.
posts.a: imagine finding the investment you want and it's closed till monday. now that one really hurts
posts.b: reach gets you in the door. execution decides if you stay. a ticker on a page is not a market
posts.c: borders were never the hard part. nobody grades a venue on how it fills when everyone wants out at once

posts.pt: Bybit usa a expectativa de IPO da Anthropic em 19/11 para vender perp 24/7: 'o mercado nao espera o sino'. E a nossa tese na voz deles, com 11 likes — resposta aparece.
posts.a: nov 19 on the calendar. my sleep schedule is not picking that date
posts.b: this is the quiet shift: the story now prices before the debut, not on it
posts.c: pre-IPO perps moving faster than the equity ever will is either genius or a warning. maybe both

posts.pt: Teaser do Bybit Stocks com a pista 'Claude' — engajamento puro, 16 respostas. Palpite especifico aqui tem chance real de aparecer.
posts.a: claude. so at least the losses will be explained politely
posts.b: the interesting part of bybit stocks isn't the ticker, it's the rail underneath it
posts.c: an AI that picks stocks is just an AI that can be wrong faster. still watching

posts.pt: DefiLlama: supply de stablecoins caiu US$ 15,7 bi em 30 dias, maior queda desde o UST (maio/2022). Numero da fonte primaria — e o combustivel do onchain encolhendo.
posts.a: the stables packed up and took the vibes with them
posts.b: thinner float means thinner books. venues that stay boring on purpose, no leverage no loops, age better in this weather
posts.c: watch execution when the float shrinks. thin books forgive nothing and remember everything

posts.pt: Elon compara RL continuo ao Edge of Tomorrow: viver o mesmo dia de novo. Alcance alto e o gancho do dia repetido vira piada facil.
posts.a: live, die, retrain. at least tom cruise got weekends off
posts.b: relentless retraining with no day off is basically what a 24/7 book does to a market maker
posts.c: humans already run this loop. we just call it monday

own_post.angulo: Contracao de stablecoins como termometro de liquidez. O numero e do proprio DefiLlama, nao meu.
own_post.texto_en: stablecoin supply just printed its biggest 30-day drop since UST in may 2022. minus $15.7B. the float got thinner, the books got thinner, and everyone remembers at the same time that liquidity was never a backdrop.
own_post.fonte: https://x.com/DefiLlama/status/2122533589309075681 (17/11 03:33Z) — US$ 15,7 bi e 'maior queda de 30 dias desde o UST', palavras do DefiLlama.

own_post.angulo: Acesso e alcance (gancho do post do Mantle), sem virar slogan 24/7.
own_post.texto_en: the ticker was never the barrier. the hours were. an asset that only moves while one timezone is awake isn't a global market, it's a local one with good PR.

own_post.angulo: IPO deixou de ser evento com sino: a historia precifica antes. Sem numero.
own_post.texto_en: an ipo used to be an event with a bell. now the story gets priced days early, by people who don't wait for one.
own_post.fonte: https://x.com/Bybit_Official/status/2122657966574690760 (17/11 11:47Z). A data de 19/11 e 'reports point to' do proprio Bybit: NAO VERIFICADO — nao citar como fato.

memes.formato_pt: Tres paineis identicos no formato 'live / die / retrain', em cima do post do Elon sobre Edge of Tomorrow.
memes.caption_en: live. die. retrain. no weekends though, that would be unhinged.

replies.pt: O site da Charles Schwab, gestora de US$ 13 tri, saiu do ar.
replies.a: the market can't crash if you can't log in
replies.b: a broker's site goes down and a trillion-dollar book goes quiet. onchain has no login screen to lose
replies.c: one broken login page and the whole book stops. that's not a market, that's a waiting room

replies.pt: Mantle: Disney e Home Depot reportam antes do pregao, Nvidia depois - os tres tokenizados pela xStocks e negociaveis 24h na Mantle via Atomic RFQ da Fluxion.
replies.a: three earnings calls, three alarms, and still missing the reaction
replies.b: atomic RFQ for size, day and night. the earnings pop doesn't have to wait for your timezone
replies.c: half the edge in earnings season is just being awake. weird thing to gate a trillion-dollar market on

replies.pt: Volume de RWA perps subiu mais de 60x no ano - US$ 98 bi em 2025 para US$ 6,3 tri em 2026 ate agora (numero do proprio DefiLlama).
replies.a: 60x in a year and nobody at dinner will believe me
replies.b: volume follows execution. size in one shot, any hour, on mantle
replies.c: 60x volume says more about execution than about new listings. the pipes were the bottleneck

replies.pt: Securitize concluiu a compra da River One; cita os quase US$ 300 bi em stablecoins e as empresas que precisam de financiamento.
replies.a: two things that have never once needed three days to settle
replies.b: digital dollars move in seconds, equities still clock out at 4pm. one of those is a choice
replies.c: stablecoins learned to settle in seconds. equities still take a coffee break at 4pm

replies.pt: 52% dos fund managers esperam corte de capex de hyperscaler de IA em ate seis meses - era 30% no mes passado e ~15% em setembro, segundo o Bank of America.
replies.a: fund managers flip faster than the capex they're worried about
replies.b: sentiment turns at 2am too. the venue shouldn't be closed when it does
replies.c: 15% in september, 52% in november. that's not analysis, that's a mood with a spreadsheet

replies.pt: CEO Carlos Domingo, no Investor Day da ParaFi: ninguem mais se chama 'internet company' - o dia em que tokenized securities forem so securities e o dia em que a coisa vira padrao.
replies.a: one day we drop the 'tokenized' prefix. today we're adding a second one.
replies.b: the prefix dies when the plumbing gets boring - 24/7 execution on mantle is what turns it from a qualifier into the default
replies.c: a 4pm close is the only thing keeping that prefix alive

replies.pt: NVDA reporta depois do fechamento; opcoes precificam movimento de ~6,88% (~US$ 10,60) pra qualquer lado, acima dos trimestres recentes (fonte: UW).
replies.a: earnings at 4pm, heart rate at 4:01. we've all been there
replies.b: 6.88% implied move and the book shuts before you can trade the reaction. onchain there's no bell between you and the print
replies.c: the options market is pricing the move. the calendar is pricing your sleep

replies.pt: Invesco (US$ 2,5 tri em ativos, fonte Superstate) lanca no FundOS o IROXX, money market fund registrado feito pra lastrear stablecoin.
replies.a: a money market fund for stablecoins - the stablecoin is now the weird part of the sentence
replies.b: registered funds wrapping stablecoins today, spot equities tomorrow. same pipes, and none of it checks the clock
replies.c: funny how the boring wrapper is the one that finally makes this feel real

replies.pt: Circle fecha parceria com Citi e World Bank Group pra usar USDC em envio de dinheiro pelo mundo.
replies.a: citi and the world bank on a stablecoin. someone's compliance team just aged five years
replies.b: rails converging: once usdc moves cross-border at bank scale, the same pipes carry tokenized equities at 3am
replies.c: banks don't adopt things. they absorb them and call it strategy

replies.pt: Bybit pergunta qual e o primeiro nome que voce indica pra quem ta comecando no crypto (post de engajamento, resposta facil).
replies.a: the friend who says 'just stack and log off' is undefeated
replies.b: start wherever, but pick a venue that doesn't clock out at 4pm. that's the whole trick
replies.c: the first name you drop says more about you than about them

modal_card.regra: Toda edicao nova do Clarim vai ao Hadukem em UM modal clicavel: link do post em cima de cada item, letras a/b/c em lista uma por linha, opcao "nenhuma" e campo de porque por item, um unico botao de envio no fim.
modal_card.mudanca_em_16_11: nenhuma — aplicado no card da manha

style_rules.anti_dup_texto: nenhuma letra repete texto de outra reply da mesma edicao; o angulo (b) varia (venue, 24h, RFQ, uptime, size) e nao repete 'a bolsa fecha' duas vezes

modal_card_v2.regra: Toda edicao do Clarim (manha, 15:00, 18:00 e Weekend Resume) sai em UM show_block com o spec exato: note curto, heading, cards com o link em cima, letras a/b/c so no part list (uma por linha, nunca no rotulo do card), opcao 'nenhuma', campo de porque por item, um unico send no fim e placeholder curto. Lista em texto puro nao e entrega: se o bloco falhar, encurta e tenta de novo.
modal_card_v2.origem: Hadukem, 17/11/2026 13:30Z - 'quero que TODOS os clarim saiam dessa mesma forma'. Spec em clarim/templates/card-escolhas-clarim.md, regra no SHARED, PR #205.

quality_feedback.pt: Nenhum feedback novo desde 14/11 ~17:00. Os 10 itens de 16/11 venceram sem escolha e nada foi publicado.
Janela de 24 posts. Segundo dia seguido com parceiro de tokenizacao ativo: Mantle publicou as 12:01Z, minutos antes do fecho da janela. Bybit fez o caminho 24/7 pela terceira vez em tres dias.

'perfeito!!! vou fazer. agora quero que anote EXATAMENTE como fez isso e quero que TODOS os clarim saiam dessa mesma forma.' Virou regra de estilo (modal_card_v2) e spec no repo. As 18:15Z reclamou que o card das 15:00 nao veio em modal - a causa era a rotina pedir 'um bloco' sem o spec; as quatro rotinas foram corrigidas e o card da noite ja saiu certo.
Dia de tres entregas (manha 10 itens, tarde 5 replies, noite 5 replies) e novamente nenhuma escolha: a ultima fala do Hadukem escolhendo item segue sendo 14/11 ~17:00. Nada publicado.

items.cena_en: Three identical panels in a row: the Fluxion mascot in a battered exo-suit helmet, visor cracked and glowing cyan, floating in a loop — same pose, same tiny chart on its nebula belly, day counter reading 001, 001, 001. Flame-tipped tail trailing behind the suit in every panel.
